title: Control Objective & Description Adequacy
prompt:
Control Objective & Description Adequacy — Is the control objective and description detailed and specific enough to effectively mitigate the associated risk (not vague or generic)?

Assess alignment of the objective and description to the risk as: Strong, Partial, or Weak.
- Strong: both are specific and detailed enough to mitigate the stated risk.
- Partial: they address the risk but remain partly generic or incomplete.
- Weak: they are vague, generic, or not specific enough to mitigate the risk.

Return alignment, alignment_rationale (max 3 sentences), and proposed_solution (max 3 sentences).
